Hi Sergio,

Thanks for the intro. As part of our procurement RFP we need a clear, auditable response on cross-border transfer assurances for your hosted API. The procurement and legal teams have a handful of focused asks so we can include your answers in our vendor due diligence pack:

1) Do you rely on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework (DPF) as your primary mechanism for transfers from EU data subjects to the US, or do you instead rely on SCCs, or a combination?

4) Do you publish a Sub-processor list and notification cadence? Do you offer a limited-subprocessor option for enterprise contracts?
5) Audit evidence: latest SOC 2 report (redacted OK), retention policy, and any independent transfer assessments.
6) Technical controls: key management (BYOK/KMS options), geo-routing/data residency controls, logging/audit trail retention.

Can you provide a DPA Annex draft and any mapping spreadsheets (SCC vs DPF) by EOD next Monday (23 Nov)? Procurement needs to include the artifacts in the final vendor pack.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call if it helps.
